editorial.licence_note: Only entries ending EXACT_FILE or EXACT_COLLECTION_OBJECT were checked against named-file/licence metadata in the source investigation. Historical public-domain assumptions are holds, never automatic clearance.
editorial.repeat_detection: URLs compared against the canonical coverage, B21 and B22 text; false means source absent in normalized exact URL string, not an exhaustive source-identity proof. Duplicated images cross-linked deliberately are not new separate photographs.
editorial.notes: This is source mining, not forty newly approved photographs, not a completion count increment and not a 1962-rubrics certification.
